newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP starts exploring near Broken Hill.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP starts exploring near Broken Hill.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd's BHP Minerals unit has begun its first significant minerals exploration work near Broken Hill in far western New South Wales (NSW) in 20 years, NSW premier Bob Carr said on Friday.
BHP is exploring for base metals and gold in the Koonenberry Belt -- an arch shaped belt of rocks extending from about 100 km east of Broken Hill north to Tibooburra, he said in a statement.

"The fact that some of Australia's largest and most successful mining companies have been attracted to the Broken Hill and Koonenberry regions and are exploring provides a sound basis for optimism," Carr said.

The exploration was a result of the state government's Discovery 2000 Exploration Initiative -- a programme designed to attract new mineral and petroleum exploration to NSW and guarantee a future for the base metal mining city of Broken Hill, Carr said.
"The programme provides high quality geological and geophysical information in key prospective areas," he said.
Carr said the high quality geophysical information supplied from Discovery 2000 has encouraged BHP Minerals to commence a programme of exploration over a large part of the area.
